MacroName wizard_objap

##################DO NOT EDIT ANYTHING IN THIS SCRIPT!#############
# Name: wizard_objap
# Author: Simon Fromm
# Version: 1.0
# SerialEM version: 4.2.X or higher
# Last update: 22.04.2026
# Support: simon.fromm@embl.de
# DOES NOT WORK AS STANDALONE. Needs to be called via the LowDoseWizard script
###################################################################

SuppressReports

Echo
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo Starting LowDoseWizard OBJECTIVE APERTURE routine
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo

#################################################
# Read in optics config file
#################################################

ReportSystemPath
ReadStringsFromFile optics $repVal1\wizard_optics_config.txt
CallStringArray optics

#################################################
# User prompts
#################################################

ParseQuotedStrings 1
header = { 'Which objective apeture size (in um) would you like to use? Choose' }
prompt1 = { '$ObjectiveAperture_1 um or' }
prompt2 = { '$ObjectiveAperture_2 um' }
buttons = { '$ObjectiveAperture_1 um' '$ObjectiveAperture_2 um'}
ThreeChoiceBox header prompt1 prompt2 buttons
If $repVal1 == 1
   objap := $ObjectiveAperture_1
   Echo $objap um objective aperture will be inserted.
ElseIf $repVal1 == 2
   objap := $ObjectiveAperture_2
   Echo $objap um objective aperture will be inserted.
Endif
ParseQuotedStrings 0

YesNoBox Would you like to correct objective lens astigmatism after aperture insertion?
astig = $repVal1
If $astig == 1
   EnterDefaultedNumber -2 1 At which defocus would you like to perform astigmatism correction? (typically -2 for SPA and -6 for tomography)
   defocus_tuning := $repVal1
Endif

#################################################
# Set area for objective aperture centering
################################################

MoveToNavItem $sample

# Check eucentricity
SetColumnOrGunValve 1
YesNoBox Is the 'sample' area at eucentric height?
If $repVal1 == 0
   V
   YesNoBox Is the current image/area suitable eucentric height determination?
   If $repVal1 == 0
      CallFunction drag_V
   Endif
   CallFunction ZwithV
   CallFunction ZwithG
Endif

# Check area
V
YesNoBox Is there some foil (carbon or gold) in the center of the image?
If $repVal1 == 0
   CallFunction drag_V
Endif

ResetImageShift

# Retrieve record mag
GoToLowDoseArea R
SetAbsoluteFocus 0
Delay 1 s
ResetDefocus
ReportMag
mag = $repVal1


# Insert and center objective aperture
ScreenDown
SetApertureSize 2 $objap
SetCamLenIndex $Cam_length
Delay 5 sec
OKBox Please center objective aperture and click OK when done. \
The objective aperture is already inserted and the microscope is in diffraction mode with the FluScreen is inserted.
SetMag $mag
GoToLowDoseArea V
GoToLowDoseArea R
Delay 3 sec
Pause Center beam with DIRECT ALIGNMENTS --> Tomo Beam shift; Then click Yes to continue
ScreenUp
Delay 5 sec

# Perform astigmatism correction
If $astig == 1
   CallFunction ZwithG
   CallFunction ZwithG
   CallFunction AutoFill
   FixAstigmatismByCTF 0 1
Endif

#################################################
# Closing message
#################################################

OKBox Completed LowDoseWizard OBJECTIVE APERTURE routine; $objap micron objective aperture has been inserted.
Echo
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo Completed LowDoseWizard OBJECTIVE APERTURE routine.
Echo $objap micron objective aperture has been inserted.
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo
